page_title: NOT 2-3 BOU | Nottingham Forest v Bournemouth 23/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' 2 - 3 Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header into the top right corner. Excellent finish.
90+3' A substitution has been made. Morgan Gibbs-White is replaced by Danilo (Nottingham).
90+2' The number of shots on goal at present is 5:6.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
86' Murillo (Nottingham) was too forceful with his tackle and Robert Jones interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
85' Today's match ends for Harry Toffolo who will be replaced by Ola Aina (Nottingham).
84' Joe Rothwell (Bournemouth) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
82' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Kieffer Moore (Bournemouth) replaces Dango Ouattara.
82' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
81' Substitution. Philip Billing is replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).

81' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nottingham.
80' The corner is swung in but Nottingham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
77' The current number of corner kicks is 3:5.

74' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Chris Wood (Nottingham) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header inside the right post. 2:2.
74' The ball goes out of play and Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Here is a change. Alex Scott is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Joe Rothwell (Bournemouth).
70' Substitution. Antoine Semenyo walks off the pitch and Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.
68' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
65' What was Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
62' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
62' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:6.
58' 1 - 2 Goal! Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:2.
58' Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.

57' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the right side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. The ball goes out for a corner. Bournemouth can continue in their attacking effort.
57' Great teamplay by Nottingham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
54' Ball possession – 29:71.

51' 1 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Marcos Senesi finds Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the roof of the net. His effort was both strong and precise, and Matt Turner had no chance of stopping that. 1:1.
50' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nottingham.

47' 1 - 0 Chris Wood passes to Anthony Elanga (Nottingham), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 1:0.
46' Orel Mangala goes off the pitch and Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) comes on.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45+3' Shots on target – 2:3.
45+2' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
43' Although Andoni Iraola (Bournemouth) is just on the bench, Robert Jones has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
40' There's an opportunity for Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
39' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
38' There's a break in play and referee Robert Jones must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bournemouth using VAR. This could be interesting!
37' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
35' 27:73 – the ratio of ball possession.
32' Bournemouth enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
31' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Alex Scott (Bournemouth) for his blatant foul.
29' Here's the change. Lewis Cook leaves the pitch and Alex Scott (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.
27' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Neto to dive and make a save.
26' Nuno Espirito Santo is forced to make a tactical change due to a red card. Divock Origi will be replaced by Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham).
25' Referee Robert Jones halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Andoni Iraola, then shows him a yellow.
23' Willy Boly (Nottingham) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
22' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) works the corner short.
19' 2:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
15' The Bournemouth players are exchanging some short passes.
13' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
13' 29:71 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
11' Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
8' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the left side of the goal, but Neto is equal to it and makes an easy save.
5' Willy Boly (Nottingham) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
4' Neco Williams (Nottingham) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
2' Bournemouth can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' The match has just started.
Today's referee will be Robert Jones.
